**Build's clean now — exits 0.**

Two real bugs, both from the bundler bump, buried under deprecation noise:

- [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Threw on `undefined.toFixed`.
- [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) treated unset `backoffEnabled` as an error. New config loader leaves it `undefined` instead of `false`. Now `undefined` maps to disabled.

Rest of the warnings are just deprecation chatter (`Buffer()`, `fs.exists`, `punycode`, etc), not actionable.

Next: nothing. Build finishes with 8 warnings, 0 errors.
